question: Which 3.1.190 LVGL v8 UI and launcher entries replace the reviewed 3.1.32 v8 ABI?
prototype_hypothesis: Prototypes are carried from the exact 3.1.32 records; the 3.1.190 bodies/names are checked independently where possible. Static-test ABI only.
callsite_evidence: 14 symbols ported from the 9_3.1.32 pack to the 3.1.190 corpus; 6 accepted by equal body plus anchored neighbourhood.

launcher_load_app_info 0xc2a308c, launcher_page_insert_icon 0xc2a1cbc and launcher_reset_order_info 0xc2a4c88 are identified by exact 3.1.190 IDB string/name evidence; the matcher's page-insert prediction was a different body.

lv_label_create/lv_img_create/lv_bar_create have equal normalized bodies and (for label_create) identical pseudocode; lv_label_set_text/lv_img_set_src have 0.989/0.997 pseudocode similarity with anchored constants.
No record carries an approval; all are restricted/PENDING/not_probed.
ownership_analysis: Launcher prototypes follow the reviewed 3.1.32 records. No ownership is promoted.
unsafe_assumptions: Two LVGL setters and three launcher entries are manual static-test accepts, not ABI-audited.
recommended_probe: Build the v8 Supervisor and run the staged loader on Mirage before any device test.
